about: A framework for building admin panels and business apps with Laravel.

prs.title: Dropdowns stay open when the window resizes
prs.broken: A dropdown opened from its button closed on the next window resize. On phones, tapping a search box inside the Filters menu opened the keyboard and closed the menu.
prs.changed: The dropdown now finds its own button correctly, so a resize no longer looks like a click somewhere else.
prs.matters: Searchable filters work on phones again.
